cues: After manganese the nuclear charge holds the d electrons too tightly.
Iron rarely goes beyond plus three, and nickel, copper and zinc stop at plus two, with copper also showing plus one.
The highest states appear only with oxygen and fluorine, as in permanganate and dichromate.
